llm.summary: This Amazon Orders skill is purpose-aligned but needs review because it can reveal customer order data and change live shipment or verification status without strong built-in safeguards.

dimensions.detail: The files coherently implement an Amazon SP-API Orders integration through LinkFox developerProxy, including order search/detail reads, buyer/address/regulated data reads, and shipment or verification updates.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill documents sensitive PII endpoints and live POST/PATCH order mutations, but it does not require explicit confirmation, dry-run validation, redaction-by-default, or clear operator controls before exposing PII or changing order state.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown and Python scripts with no install hook, package dependency install, background service, or automatic persistence behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Use of LINKFOXAGENT_API_KEY, Amazon access tokens, outbound calls to the documented LinkFox gateway, and an optional base URL override is disclosed and fits the integration, but users must treat those values as sensitive.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No credential storage, privilege escalation, destructive filesystem actions, broad local indexing, or long-running worker behavior was found; local filesystem access is limited to dependency-skill discovery.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only for users authorized to access the relevant Amazon seller account and customer order data. Keep the gateway URL on a trusted endpoint, use least-privilege Amazon roles and RDT controls, redact stdout/logs/support tickets, and require a deliberate human confirmation before shipment confirmation, shipment status updates, or regulated-order verification changes.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Environment variables, shell execution of local scripts, and outbound network calls are real capabilities, but they are disclosed in the skill and are necessary for the documented gateway-backed SP-API workflow.
[SQP-2] expected: Buyer info, shipping address, order-item buyer info, and regulated-order reads are expected for an Orders skill, but the artifacts return raw JSON to stdout and provide only limited PII handling guidance.
[SQP-2] expected: updateShipmentStatus, updateVerificationStatus, and confirmShipment are explicitly documented order-management capabilities, but they perform live mutations without a documented confirmation gate or rollback guidance.
[SQP-2] unexpected: The feedback guidance asks for complete developerProxy JSON with only a brief redaction note; that is overbroad because these payloads may contain customer data or token-adjacent request details.
[SQP-2] expected: Forwarding seller identifiers and Amazon access tokens to the documented LinkFox gateway is consistent with the stated architecture; the optional base URL override should be used only with a trusted endpoint.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan was clean and did not identify hidden malicious behavior.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean and is treated as supporting telemetry only, not the basis for the verdict.
